body:
READ-ONLY PRODUCT AUDIT — REJECT THE CURRENT PREVIEW AS THE PRODUCT VIEW; RETAIN IT ONLY AS A MECHANICAL/PRINT REGRESSION ARTIFACT

Artifact identity and method

- `preview.html`: SHA-256 `513cf128116cfbedca54693fea4b9aa93305cca893d0bb7839de12da3f774beb`, 170455 bytes, 2028 lines.
- supplied PNG: SHA-256 `e9d4ccfba9f8f578750ce830c1d0a6608c4a43844ba8c637ebca2b850137ea21`, 570031 bytes, 1800 x 2400 pixels.
- I inspected the supplied PNG at original resolution and the exact HTML source. I did not run browser automation, inspect the provider recovery paths, or conduct a human study. This is an artifact/DOM acceptance audit, not a claim about reader accuracy, preference, or accessibility performance.

What a first-time reader can recover

1. The document identifies itself as Narrative Codex, names The War of the Ghosts, and visibly states the researcher-reviewed fixture basis (`preview.html` lines 25-27).
2. The canonical story text is visibly laid out as two bordered pages. The receipt states 46 lines, two pages, 131 annotations, and 648 annotation fragments (lines 48-53).
3. The collapsed receipt exposes source/compiler/configuration identities and deterministic layout inputs (lines 29-54).
4. The reader learns that five broad families exist — hierarchy, entity, relation, context, and claim — and that they occupy 18 fixed row positions (lines 27 and 54).

That is useful mechanical evidence: the text survived, the artifact has a declared basis, and annotation geometry was produced. It is not yet an inspectable semantic report.

What the reader cannot recover, with source-to-observation trace

1. No visible mark has a recoverable typed meaning. The source contains 648 polygons; all 648 use exactly `fill="#a0a0a0"`, `fill-opacity="0.3"`, and `stroke="none"`. Each enclosing group exposes only an opaque annotation hash plus page/line/fragment coordinates such as `annotation:a821183300c9/p0/l0/r0` (first examples at lines 66-100). There is no per-mark hierarchy/entity/relation/context/claim label or endpoint. The legend names lane families globally but does not bind one gray fragment to one fact.
2. There is no same-document navigation. Exact counts are zero anchors, zero fragment `href`s, zero `tabindex`, and zero ARIA attributes. CSS explicitly sets the overlay to `pointer-events: none` (line 19). A keyboard or pointer user cannot select a story/recall fact and follow it to evidence or a textual twin.
3. There is no graphical relation or hierarchy structure to inspect. Across the document there are 648 SVG polygons and three `<title>` elements (one HTML document title and one title in each of the two page SVGs), but zero SVG `path`, `line`, `text`, or `desc` elements. Chronology, causality, parent/child hierarchy, relation endpoints, and direction cannot be recovered from screen geometry. The word `relation` appears only in the coarse legend/row map.
4. There is no in-document semantic textual twin. The only annotation inventory is the count and row-family map in the receipt. Annotation hashes occur as graphical `data-name` attributes, not as labelled table rows linked bidirectionally to marks. This does not meet the accepted contract's requirement that essential state and the complete twin exist in the initial document.
5. Recall alignment is absent. Case-insensitive source counts are zero for recall, posterior, Viterbi, transition, faithful, distorted, Association, Commentary, Intrusion, Uninterpretable, and Unranked. A reader cannot follow one recall idea unit to a source alternative, distinguish P from F, see exact mass, or learn whether a route is backward, a long jump, a revisit, or an external excursion.
6. Epistemic and support states are absent. Source counts are zero for missing, imputed, suppressed, unavailable, and evidence. The artifact therefore cannot distinguish measured zero from absent state-space membership, provider abstention, view suppression, refusal, or unestablished eligibility. This does not prove that the underlying fixture has such states; it proves the report has no vocabulary with which to disclose them if it does.
7. The supplied screenshot confirms the perceptual consequence: most visible annotation fragments become near-identical hairlines behind the monospaced source. The story remains readable and the existence of annotation is apparent, but no one typed relationship can be decoded. The gray overlay competes with the text without explaining it.

Typed-contract consequences

- Source hierarchy/evidence exists upstream, but the artifact publishes no named source node, parent, level, or exact evidence link.
- `P`, `F`, and Viterbi are distinct quantities in candidate `a7fa64a`; the artifact publishes none. A later view must never reconstruct F from row winners or let Viterbi replace P/F.
- Faithful, distorted facets, and six external states are typed alternatives; one gray treatment cannot carry those distinctions.
- Measured zero, absent/unavailable, missing, imputed, refused, suppressed, and ineligible are different facts; blank space and identical gray cannot stand for all of them.
- Discourse order, story-world order, chronology, and causality may disagree; a generic relation lane cannot establish which coordinate or relation a mark represents.
- The current artifact is therefore not scientifically false on its own — it calls itself lens Overview and does not invent recall output — but it is insufficient as the owner-prioritized end-to-end product milestone.

Smallest self-contained static redesign

Keep the exact source text, basis/identity header, receipt, and deterministic pagination. Replace the 18-row gray wall as the primary view with one recall-unit-centred packet per section. Use only ordinary anchors, `:target`/`:focus-visible`, native `details`/`summary`, labelled CSS patterns/glyphs, and optional inline SVG. No JavaScript, external resource, server, or colour-only meaning is required.

Compact wireframe:

```
+------------------------------------------------------------------+
| RESULT: VALIDATED SEMANTICS | LOCAL-SENSITIVE | basis + receipts |
| or: SOURCE ACCEPTED — SEMANTICS NOT ESTABLISHED                  |
+------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Recall units: [u0] [u1] [u2 selected] [u3]                      |
+-----------------------+------------------------------------------+
| RECALL u2             | PLACEMENT P                              |
| exact transcript span | e5 faithful       exact mass [solid]      |
| function + uncertainty| e5 distorted/role exact mass [stripe]     |
| evidence link         | Intrusion         exact mass [cross]      |
|                       | shown mass + exact undisplayed remainder  |
+-----------------------+------------------------------------------+
| FLOW F into/out of u2 | exact endpoints, mass, backward/jump/... |
| Viterbi (secondary)   | one identified MAP path; never “mapping” |
+-----------------------+------------------------------------------+
| SOURCE e5 [target]    | hierarchy: scene sc2 > situation e5      |
| exact evidence spans  | discourse/world-time/causal facts separate|
| support/status        | observed / imputed / unavailable / ...   |
+------------------------------------------------------------------+
| COMPLETE TEXTUAL TWIN: P rows, F rows, costs, statuses, receipts |
+------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

The wireframe contains field labels, not measured Anna values.

Every unit index link targets a deterministic `<section id="recall-u2">`. Every placement/flow row links to its source/recall evidence section, and each evidence section links back. Optional visual bars or edges link to exactly one textual row by stable mark id. The table is primary and complete when CSS/SVG is disabled. `details` may hide full low-mass rows visually, but their exact values, suppression rule, count, and undisplayed mass remain in the initial DOM. Viterbi is a secondary labelled row, not an overlay that obscures P/F. The source-only route renders the first status banner, exact source identities/text, and no semantic marks or fixture basis.

At most eight executable observable assertions

1. STATIC PROFILE AND DIRECT OPEN. Open the exact fixture `preview.html` under `file://` with network disabled. Assert nonblank outcome, source identity, unit index, selected-unit packet, and textual twin; assert no script/handler/external or sibling resource and permit a same-document `url(#pattern)` positive control. A sibling/network URL mutant fails profile certification without erasing semantic/result artifacts.
2. SOURCE-ONLY NEGATIVE CONTROL. For arbitrary source intake with no admitted semantic result, assert exact source identity/text plus a visible `Semantics not established` outcome, and assert absence of semantic overlay marks, P/F/Viterbi tables, semantic `ViewBasis`, omission claims, and borrowed fixture identifiers. Mutating the page to reuse the fixture graph/basis fails.
3. UNIT IDENTITY, FOCUS, AND TWIN CLOSURE. On the hand-checkable Anna fixture, tab through recall units in ordinal order; selecting `u2` visibly focuses its section. Assert exact unit id, transcript SpanSet, function, expressed uncertainty, and bidirectional links among each visual mark, its textual row, recall evidence, and source evidence. Delete either direction or swap a span and fail.
4. POSTERIOR P WITHOUT FLATTERING. For `u2` and the bimodal/role-reversal/unranked foils, compare every textual state key and exact mass to the admitted P row. Assert faithful versus each distorted facet, all six named external states or explicit unavailable status, present zero versus absent key, frozen top-k/threshold, visible sum, and undisplayed remainder without renormalization. Argmax-only, mass duplication, or remainder rescaling fails.
5. TRANSITION F, NOT INFERRED ROUTES. With P fixed, use validator-admissible F-only foils whose adjacent marginals still equal those P rows. Assert the incoming/outgoing tables and linked marks equal exact F endpoints/masses and declared Backward, LongJump, revisit, mode-change, or external-excursion facts. The rendered flow must change while P does not. An arbitrary F mutation that breaks the marginals must refuse rather than render; connecting row winners or screen-nearest nodes fails.
6. VITERBI IS SECONDARY AND WELL FORMED. Assert Viterbi is labelled as one identified model-relative MAP path beside P/F. Removing its presentation leaves every P/F fact unchanged. A Viterbi state absent from its P-row keys refuses publication rather than being inserted, hidden, or treated as truth.
7. SOURCE EVIDENCE, HIERARCHY, AND COORDINATE DIVERGENCE. From one displayed placement, follow links to exact recall and source SpanSets, source node kind, parent/level, deterministic discourse rank, optional measured discourse position/story-world rank, and any displayed typed relation identities. Changing pagination changes geometry only. As a deliberate E0 strengthening from the output contract rather than an `a7fa64a` conformance requirement, add a fixture where discourse/story-world/causal facts disagree and a displayed relation crosses a page; those typed facts remain unchanged.
8. STATUS, SUPPORT, AND OMISSION HONESTY. Use equal-valued measured and imputed terms plus missing, refused, suppressed, unavailable, and present-zero controls. Assert distinct text labels and non-colour patterns, exact reasons/support, retained hidden-value accounting, and the explicit term-level label `eligibility unavailable in this artifact`; do not synthesize `Ineligible` from current `CostBreakdown`. A low-mass source says `omission not established` unless a separately checked companion supplies the declared universe, eligibility, estimand, threshold, and denominator. Only then may an eligible-low-mass foil receive the frozen omission label. Blank/zero/default-license/fabricated-ineligible mutants fail.

These are executable DOM/fixture assertions, not a usability study. They can prove identity, completeness, navigation, and non-conflation. They cannot prove that readers are faster, more accurate, prefer the design, or achieve an accessibility-performance outcome; those claims require the separately governed participant study described by the output contract.

Priority order

P0. Ship the two honest outcome banners and the source-only negative control.
P0. Make one selected recall unit fully inspectable: exact unit/evidence, P, F, secondary Viterbi, support/status, and source links.
P0. Close graphical/textual twin and keyboard-focus loops with stable same-document ids.
P1. Add source hierarchy plus separate discourse/world-time/causal facts and the complete low-mass tables.
P1. Add optional compact bars/edges using labelled shapes/patterns after the textual packet is complete.
P2. Retain the current full-story gray-lane overview only as a secondary mechanical/print layer, never as the primary semantic explanation.

Verdict: REJECT as product milestone; RETAIN as useful mechanical regression evidence. The smallest acceptable successor is a static, unit-centred, evidence-linked P/F packet with a complete textual twin and an explicit source-only `Semantics not established` route.
